attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1, node2, node3; Alpine 3.23, MariaDB 11.4.12 + Galera 26.4.13) with wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3 and mariabackup as the SST method. Root-caused and fixed two BusyBox tool incompatibilities (lsof and ps) that were silently breaking Galera's state-transfer scripts. Verified multi-master writes propagate to all members, verified the cluster stays available and automatically resyncs a member after an outage, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart protocol on all three nodes with confirmed boot-identity changes and full cluster recovery after each restart.
